summary: Model Agentforce targets as explicit dependencies
rationale: AiAuthoringBundle Agent Script and legacy Agentforce metadata can invoke Flows, Apex and Prompt Templates across deployment waves. Explicit graph edges are required to prevent unsafe simplification and invalid ordering.
outcome: The scanner will model AiAuthoringBundle and legacy Agentforce targets as graph dependencies; availability and simplification will use the resulting relationships.
alternatives: Treat Agentforce metadata as opaque files
Infer dependencies only from metadata type ordering
